doc.title: Sam Kininger interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 27, 2011

title: Scheduling and playing locally
summary: Coordinating schedules and opportunities in Syracuse and Albany.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: They probably all — it’s probably hard to get everybody’s schedule coordinated and say okay when are you free.
Yeah. Especially now, everybody’s doing something all the time.
Sure. That’s pretty much the life of a musician, you’ve got to take —
Would there be opportunities in this area for you to play?
You know I have kind of a network of people in Syracuse and in Albany, but I usually have to drag my Boston band back to the area. If there were opportunities, definitely I would.
